conf.description: Facility SNMP UPS-MIB/PowerNet-MIB poll-mode direct route: normalize an external SNMP-poller's scalar sample into the same ECS shape as the trap route, per recommendations.direct.cribl (stateful diff-to-event transition detection is out of scope - see README gap)

conf.comment: External net-snmp/Telegraf-style poller sample of the UPS-MIB/PowerNet-MIB scalar groups (no Elastic integration, no Cribl SNMP GET source). Per-object diff-to-transition detection needs a stateful store the whitelisted functions here cannot provide (join needs a pre-existing stageId); this pipeline normalizes and units-scales one sample per event and leaves transition synthesis to the collector or Elastic.
